title: PredictBot forecast ledger -- one JSON object per line (JSONL), append-only
description: Every line is ONE EVENT for exactly one forecast_id. A forecast's current state is the merge of every event recorded for its forecast_id, in file order -- never a single mutated record. Every forecast generated is recorded here, including those never placed as a ticket (selection_status starts at 'considered' and only reaches 'placed' via a SELECTION_UPDATED event cross-referenced from betting_ledger.v1's PLACED event legs).

RECORDED.description: model_probabilities/model_version/artifact_hash/input_hash/output_hash are ALL nullable together -- a STOP-rejected candidate that never had a model run on it is recorded with every one of these null, never a fabricated placeholder. When model_probabilities is non-null, model_version/artifact_hash/output_hash MUST also be non-null (provenance is mandatory alongside any real probability -- enforced in code by forecast_ledger.py's _require_model_provenance, not just documented here).

model_role.description: e.g. 'CANDIDATE_SHADOW' -- null for the incumbent's own rows (see ledgers/forecast_ledger.py::build_recorded_event's own docstring).

capture_hash.description: Content hash of the exact capture file used -- distinct from capture_id, the capture's own session id.

alias_hash.description: SHA-256 of the exact team_aliases.json content used to resolve this fixture -- see ledgers/forecast_ledger.py::build_recorded_event's own docstring.

FIXTURE_RESCHEDULED.description: Appended when a LATER capture of an already-recorded fixture reports a genuinely different kickoff_utc (and/or scheduled_date) with every other identity/model field unchanged -- see forecast_ledger.py's own module docstring and build_fixture_rescheduled_event. A fixture may legitimately carry more than one of these events over time (each one a distinct, append-only chain link -- see forecast_ledger.py::decide_fixture_reschedule_append); kickoff_utc/scheduled_date at the payload's top level mirror the NEW values verbatim, so latest_state's merge reflects the fixture's current schedule.
